body.name: G
body.def: For \(c=t/(1-t)\) and \(0<t<1\), \(G(u,z)(t)=(1+c)\sum_{j\in\mathcal J}p_j\ell_{c,b_j}(Ru_j,Rz_j)\); \(G(u,z)(0)=\sum_{j\in\mathcal J}p_j[\max_{a\in\mathcal A}(Ru_j)_a-(Ru_j)^{\top}q_{0,b_j}\{R(u_j+z_j)\}]\); and \(G(u,z)(1)=\frac12\sum_{j\in\mathcal J}p_jz_j^{\top}R^{\top}C(b_j)Rz_j\)
